parts:
Hi,

To model only the available years, first remap them to 1:numbers (e.g. convert to factor and then as.numeric).
To model all the years from first to last, use
group= time - min(time) +1

For case 1, set n.group as you did before.
For case 2, n.group=max(time)-min(time)+1

Finn

At 2022-07-09 21:32:51, "Finn Lindgren" <finn.l...@gmail.com> wrote:

Do you have gaps in your time variable?
make.A uses the group variable as an index from 1 to n.group, so you need n.group=max(time) to be sure to get the correct number of groups. length(unique(time)) will not be the right thing if you have gaps in the time variable.

Finn
